Class HuntEventCard

java.lang.Object
model.cards.Card
model.cards.TribeCard
model.cards.eventCards.EventCard
model.cards.eventCards.HuntEventCard
public class HuntEventCard extends EventCard
Represents the global concrete event execution card for the Hunt phase.

This event class evaluates a direct linear scaling payoff based on the current population of hunter characters within each player's tribe. Food generation remains constant per unit, whereas prestige point yields are progressively scaled by a dynamic environmental multiplier derived from the active Era. After the baseline rewards are computed, the class dispatches execution to any reactive building extensions bound to the event hook.

    EventResolutionDto
    resolve(List<Player> players)
    Algorithmic Resolution Pipeline: Computes the chronological scaling index: eraIndex = era.ordinal() + 1 (e.g., 1 for ERA_I, 2 for ERA_II, 3 for ERA_III). Iterates through each active game participant to evaluate state metrics. Applies linear primary yields: directly credits the player with 1 food unit per hunter, and awards prestige points equivalent to hunterCount * eraIndex. Dispatches lifecycle callbacks to all registered OnEventBuildingEffect instances executing the OnEventBuildingEffect.applyOnHunt(Player) hook to resolve building-specific bonuses. Snapshots mutated resource pools and compiles the delta metrics into a client-bound PlayerEventDeltaDto wrapper.

      public EventResolutionDto resolve(List<Player> players)
      Algorithmic Resolution Pipeline:
      1. Computes the chronological scaling index: eraIndex = era.ordinal() + 1 (e.g., 1 for ERA_I, 2 for ERA_II, 3 for ERA_III).
      2. Iterates through each active game participant to evaluate state metrics.
      3. Applies linear primary yields: directly credits the player with 1 food unit per hunter, and awards prestige points equivalent to hunterCount * eraIndex.
      4. Dispatches lifecycle callbacks to all registered OnEventBuildingEffect instances executing the OnEventBuildingEffect.applyOnHunt(Player) hook to resolve building-specific bonuses.
      5. Snapshots mutated resource pools and compiles the delta metrics into a client-bound PlayerEventDeltaDto wrapper.
